scope: Read-only CPU review of six new stage modules; no root-source edits; no GPU calls, installs, credentials, source model mutation, or old output writes.
overall: No observed full-SH replacement, original TEST image read, permission unlock, selected-only visibility render, Gaussian contribution top-k truncation, or test-based selection in these six modules. Concrete metric/media/seal robustness findings require root disposition before production. Runner was not available at this review snapshot.

verified.qualification: All roles are original GS TRAIN seen; prior F/C usage is enumerated and dev/prior arc are explicitly seen. No new formal blind TEST claim.
verified.native_alpha_support: Override feature images preserve full primitive traversal/occlusion; color Jacobian uses full-model native backward, not TOP4.
verified.full_SH: PLY header checks45 rest coefficients/degree3 before load; official native SH forward retained; DC edits preserve all original rest SH.
verified.permissions: Original base tensors are frozen. Editor uses selected-row DC delta and optional bounded log-scale/raw-quaternion deltas; audit requires byte-equivalent original center/opacity/rest and all nonselected rows.
verified.coverage: Covariance arm actually renders native alpha with geometry autograd and includes reliable foreground one-sided deficit plus continuous AA outline loss; ordinary control has the same parameter permissions and coverage/regularizer.
verified.selector: Training views only; count frozen from ceil0.10N cap32768; exact full contribution masses, balanced target evidence, own full-image mass density, visibility weighting; random matches joint visibility/logmass strata.
verified.media: Same cameras in row panels; overlay from B0 full-model selected alphaT; videos render actual shared3D native model per frozen camera; decode enforces all expected frames and unique decoded hashes.
verified.loss_encoding: Display/native PNG RGB. Width alone explicitly decodes sRGB to linear; rendered unclipped floats are retained for metrics.

findings.issue: Native edge-crop cells can be49px wide, but full keys such as relative_cov_ordinary need about140px; labels overlap and nearest enlargement preserves the overlap.
findings.recommendation: Use legible wider cells with native pixels centered, or a separate key legend; retain exact subplot keys.

findings.issue: Training outside_damage uses1-internal_band; evaluation outside_damage uses1-max(internal_band,outline_band). Same metric name currently denotes different regions.
findings.recommendation: Align masks or explicitly report both named region definitions in results/report.

findings.issue: Comment claims mirror source training resize, but stock PILtoTorch uses PIL.resize default RGB BICUBIC while this stage explicitly uses BILINEAR. Display encoding/compositing/quantization are preserved, but resampling differs.
findings.recommendation: Declare BILINEAR as the new512 reduction and remove exact stock-preprocessing implication, or use the stock filter before sealing targets.

findings.issue: Holdout loader accepts any existing holdout_seal path; it does not authenticate completed scene/model/selection/config/data freeze content. No observed actual leak.
findings.recommendation: Require actual root completed seal and verify its schema/hash fields; review runner ordering before holdout reads.

findings.issue: ART/videos directory is assumed to exist. Missing directory would fail ffmpeg, after all render work.
findings.recommendation: Create video.parent in videos or ensure this invariant explicitly in runner.

findings.issue: Stage cap currently counts OUT only, omitting new stage EXP and ART bytes. Expected present media size is small, but total-stage wording is broader.
findings.recommendation: Aggregate EXP+ART+OUT for the16GiB stage cap.

cpu_photo_sanity.interpretation: Widths on these natural views may be mostly or wholly null. Keep fixed thresholds; band/allforeground/outline metrics and actual target-defined zooms remain valid. Do not fabricate widths or tune this evaluator on these scene examples.

limitations: No native GPU run by reviewer; root native-test pass claim is separate evidence.
No production runner or report present at review snapshot, so authentic seal sequencing and per-arm ownership gates await runner review.
